Collision |ranged_damage = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]]6 |ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]0.12 |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]24 |speed = 4 |hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Yes}} |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} (Collision only) |flying = {{Attr|Flying|Yes}} }} ==Description== The '''Golden Tommy Goon 2''', also referred to as '''Upgraded Golden Tommy Crook''', is a unit that can be spawned from the [[Golden Crook Boss]] at Level 4, replacing the [[Golden Tommy Goon 1]]. On the wiki, it is referred to as ''Golden Tommy Goon 2'' to differentiate itself from the [[Golden Tommy Goon 1]], as both use the same display name in-game. It is an upgraded version of the [[Tommy Goon 2]], with it having higher damage, higher health and faster firerate than the [[Tommy Goon 2]]. Like most other units, it starts from one of the entrances of the map and moves towards the exit. Whenever there is an enemy in its range, it will stop moving to attack it and all other detectable enemies in its range. It will continue walking if there are no enemies in its range for a few seconds. The '''Golden Tommy Goon 2''' can detect hidden enemies, though it cannot detect flying enemies. It has a 31 second spawnrate. There is a limit of three '''Golden Tommy Goon 2''' and [[Golden Tommy Goon 2]]s per [[Golden Crook Boss]]. It will last 150 seconds on the map before dying. ==Appearance== The '''Golden Tommy Goon 2''' has two black and golden prosthetic arms and a helmet. It wears a golden shirt, black jacket with golden highlights, black pants and tie, brown shoes and a black fedora with a golden stripe. [[Tower Defense Simulator Toys|Merch Shop]]Obtained by purchasing the [[Narrator Plush]]. |[[Beach Crate]] |} ==Strategy== *The '''Golden Tommy Goon 2''' can be quite useful against enemies that appear in later parts of the game, as it has decent DPS, spawns quickly and has hidden detection, thought it should not be solely relied on. *The '''Golden Tommy Goon 2''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with defense, like the [[Giant Boss]] or [[Elite Hazmat]]. **Its gun damage is still reduced by defense. *On maps with multiple paths, only one '''Golden Tommy Goon 2''' spawns per [[Golden Crook Boss]], it will go down a random path. *The '''Golden Tommy Goon 2''' is unaffected by buffs and debuffs. *The '''Golden Tommy Goon 2''' will struggle against enemies with abilities that deal damage to units because of its low health. **You may want to use the [[Field Medic]] to protect it against such attacks. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''10 February 2024''' -
